description: Flat metadata schema for individual X-ray phase-contrast microscopy records of cultured human epithelial cells exposed to ionizing radiation, including sample preparation, irradiation, acquisition, and image processing details.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record or image/observation file.

specimen_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biological sample, culture well, or dish from which the image was acquired.

cell_type.descr: Human epithelial cell type or line name (for example: HeLa, A549, MCF10A).

cell_origin.descr: Source/origin of the cell line or primary cells, including tissue or donor provenance if known.

species.descr: Organism species; expected value: Homo sapiens.

culture_format.descr: Culture configuration used during imaging, such as monolayer, 3D spheroid, organoid, or on-membrane culture.

substrate_or_support_material.descr: Material supporting the cells during imaging, such as glass, silicon nitride membrane, polymer film, or plastic dish.

substrate_thickness_um.descr: Thickness of the support substrate or window in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

coating_material.descr: Surface coating or ECM used for cell attachment, such as collagen, fibronectin, or poly-L-lysine.

coating_concentration_ug_ml.descr: Concentration of coating material in micrograms per milliliter (µg/mL), if applicable.

seeding_density_cells_per_cm2.descr: Cell seeding density at plating, in cells per square centimeter (cells/cm^2).

confluency_percent.descr: Estimated cell confluency at the time of irradiation or imaging, as a percentage (0-100).

culture_medium.descr: Complete culture medium used during growth or imaging.

serum_percent.descr: Serum concentration in the culture medium, expressed as percent (%).

incubation_duration_h.descr: Duration of the relevant culture or incubation step in hours (h).

sample_fixation.descr: Whether the sample was chemically fixed before imaging.

fixative_agent.descr: Fixative used, such as paraformaldehyde, glutaraldehyde, or methanol.

fixative_concentration_percent.descr: Fixative concentration in percent (%), if applicable.

fixation_time_min.descr: Fixation time in minutes (min), if applicable.

dehydration_used.descr: Whether a dehydration series was used before imaging.

dehydration_protocol.descr: Description of dehydration protocol, including solvents and concentrations.

staining_used.descr: Whether stains, labels, or contrast agents were applied before imaging.

stain_or_contrast_agent.descr: Name of stain or contrast agent used, such as osmium tetroxide, uranyl acetate, or fluorescent label.

radiation_type.descr: Type of ionizing radiation used for exposure, such as X-rays, gamma rays, protons, electrons, or heavy ions.

radiation_dose_rate_gy_min.descr: Dose rate in gray per minute (Gy/min), if known.

radiation_energy_kev.descr: Radiation energy in kilo-electronvolts (keV), if applicable.

radiation_flux_photons_s.descr: Photon flux at the sample in photons per second (photons/s), if applicable.

irradiation_to_imaging_interval_min.descr: Time interval between irradiation and imaging in minutes (min).

radiation_field_size_mm2.descr: Irradiated field size on the sample in square millimeters (mm^2).

radiation_source_type.descr: X-ray source type or radiation source platform, such as synchrotron, microfocus tube, or laser-plasma source.

xray_tube_target_material.descr: Target/anode material for an X-ray tube source, if applicable (for example: Cu, Mo, W).

xray_source_model.descr: Manufacturer and model of the X-ray source or beamline hardware.

beamline_or_instrument_name.descr: Beamline, instrument, or facility name used for acquisition.

monochromated.descr: Whether the X-ray beam was monochromated.

monochromator_type.descr: Monochromator type or element used, if applicable.

beam_energy_kev.descr: Incident beam energy at the sample in keV.

beam_wavelength_nm.descr: Incident beam wavelength in nanometers (nm), if known.

energy_bandwidth_percent.descr: Relative energy bandwidth of the beam in percent (%), if known.

beam_size_um.descr: Beam size at sample plane in micrometers (µm), if relevant.

sample_to_detector_distance_mm.descr: Distance from sample to detector in millimeters (mm).

phase_contrast_mode.descr: Phase-contrast modality used, such as propagation-based, Zernike, grating-based, or inline phase contrast.

objective_magnification_x.descr: Microscope objective magnification, as a numeric fold increase (×).

detector_type.descr: Detector type, such as CCD, CMOS, scintillator-coupled camera, or direct detector.

effective_pixel_size_um.descr: Effective sample-plane pixel size in micrometers (µm) after optical magnification.

image_dimensions_px.descr: Image dimensions in pixels, formatted as a string such as '2048x2048'.

exposure_time_ms.descr: Detector exposure time per frame in milliseconds (ms).

number_of_frames.descr: Number of raw frames acquired for this record, if multiple frames were collected.

frame_averaging_used.descr: Whether multiple frames were averaged during acquisition.

binning_factor.descr: Detector binning factor used during acquisition, if any.

pixel_correction_applied.descr: Whether dark-field, flat-field, or bad-pixel corrections were applied.

dark_field_correction.descr: Whether dark-field correction was applied during processing.

flat_field_correction.descr: Whether flat-field correction was applied during processing.

bad_pixel_correction.descr: Whether bad-pixel correction was applied during processing.

image_alignment_used.descr: Whether images were aligned or registered relative to each other.

image_correlation_method.descr: Image correlation or registration method used, such as cross-correlation, phase correlation, mutual information, fiducial-based, or optical flow.

image_registration_reference.descr: Reference image, frame, or marker used for alignment or correlation.

correlation_similarity_metric.descr: Similarity metric used for registration or correlation, if applicable (for example: Pearson correlation, normalized cross-correlation).

reconstruction_algorithm.descr: Algorithm used to reconstruct phase or tomographic images, if applicable.

phase_retrieval_method.descr: Phase retrieval method used, such as Paganin, transport-of-intensity, or iterative reconstruction.

software_name.descr: Name of the software used for processing or analysis.

software_version.descr: Software version used for processing or analysis.

software_vendor.descr: Developer, vendor, or institution associated with the software.

processing_pipeline_description.descr: Brief description of the processing workflow applied to the raw images.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize image intensities or backgrounds.

noise_reduction_method.descr: Noise reduction or denoising method used, if any.

segmentation_method.descr: Method used to segment organelles, cytoskeletal structures, or cellular boundaries, if applicable.

analysis_output_type.descr: Type of derived output produced for this record, such as raw image, corrected image, reconstructed phase map, segmentation mask, or quantitative feature table.

quantitative_feature_name.descr: Name of a measured quantitative feature extracted from the image, if applicable, such as organelle area, texture metric, or intensity mean.

quantitative_feature_value.descr: Numeric value of the extracted feature, if applicable.

quantitative_feature_units.descr: Units for the extracted feature value, if applicable.

quality_flag.descr: General quality status of the record, such as pass, warning, or fail.

artifact_present.descr: Whether visible imaging artifacts, motion artifacts, or processing artifacts were detected.

artifact_description.descr: Description of any observed artifacts, such as drift, ring artifacts, saturation, or beam damage.

radiation_damage_observed.descr: Whether radiation-induced damage phenotypes were observed in the imaged cell(s).

damage_phenotype_description.descr: Description of observed structural changes, such as membrane blebbing, organelle swelling, or cytoskeletal disruption.

imaging_date.descr: Date of image acquisition in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, if recorded.

processing_date.descr: Date when image processing or analysis was performed in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD, if recorded.

operator_id.descr: Identifier or initials of the operator who performed the imaging or processing.

notes.descr: Any additional free-text notes relevant to this specific record.
